build_physics_simulation_network: build a PhysicsSimulationNetwork Haiku module to simulate a physical system with neural network-defined energy
run_physics_simulation: run PhysicsSimulationNetwork simulate method to evolve a phase space state forward and backward in time
build_ode_network: build an OdeNetwork Haiku module to simulate continuous dynamics defined by a neural ODE
run_discrete_dynamics: run DiscreteDynamicsNetwork simulate method to evolve a state through discrete time steps with optional residual connections
compute_hamiltonian_lagrangian: compute the Hamiltonian or Lagrangian of a PhysicsSimulationNetwork given a phase space state
